# `scripts/fp/activity/`

## `scripts/fp/activity/activity_beacons.gd`

extends `Node3D`

World beacons for the AI activity layer: one per agent key ("mayor:1", "council", "chaos"), a tall light column in the agent's colour over the tile its latest decision touched, with a ring on the ground that pulses while the decision is new and dims once it is old. Visual only: no collision, hidden in photo mode by the feature.

### Constants

- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `BEAM_H = 110.0 * WS.M`
- `BEAM_R = 0.9 * WS.M`
- `RING_R = 7.0 * WS.M`
- `RING_W = 0.6 * WS.M`
- `FRESH = 30.0`: Seconds a beacon pulses as new, and after which it settles to its dim strength.
- `STALE = 480.0`
- `BEAM_SHADER = """`

### Functions

- `func place(key: String, pos: Vector3, col: Color, fresh: bool = true) -> void`: Puts the beacon for key at pos (feet on the ground) in col; fresh restarts its pulse.
- `func remove(key: String) -> void`
- `func clear() -> void`
- `func has_beacon(key: String) -> bool`
- `func position_of(key: String) -> Vector3`
- `func keys() -> Array`
- `func freshness(key: String) -> float`: 0..1: how new the beacon is (1 just placed, 0 once FRESH has passed).

## `scripts/fp/activity/activity_feature.gd`

extends `FpFeature`

AI activity (integration feature "activity"): the city's AI decisions, visible from the street. Every mayor's turn, council ruling, Chaos Director pick, grid order and Gazette front page lands as a card in the feed (top right) that names who decided and the model they run on, whether the answer came live, from a replay, a fallback or the offline planner, what they did and why, and where. A decision with a place also raises a light beacon there (tagged when the hero is near) and pings the compass and minimap in the agent's colour. In street mode the mayors take their turns spread over the day (CityBrain.stagger_mayors), so decisions keep landing while you walk. J cycles the feed (full, brief, hidden); G routes the GPS to the newest decision with a place.

### Constants

- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd")`
- `W = preload("res://scripts/fp/activity/activity_words.gd")`
- `FEED = preload("res://scripts/fp/activity/activity_feed.gd")`
- `BEACONS = preload("res://scripts/fp/activity/activity_beacons.gd")`
- `TAGS = preload("res://scripts/fp/activity/activity_tags.gd")`
- `CITY_HALL = Vector2i(15, 14)`: Where the council sits when no City Hall tile is found (CitySim.new_city builds it here).
- `KEEP = 12`: Decisions kept for the save; the feed shows the newest FEED.MAX_CARDS.
- `REFRESH = 0.25`
- `HERE = 0.75`: Within this many tiles the place line reads "here" instead of a distance.
- `TICKER_H = 240.0`: Height of the chat ticker strip at the bottom of chat_slot (the last lines while it is closed).
- `SAVED_TEXT = [ "key", "agent", "who", "model", "source", "headline", "short", "detail", "extra" ]`

### Properties

- `items: Array[Dictionary]`: Oldest first: {"key" ("mayor:<mi>" or the support role), "agent" ("<mi>" or the role), "who", "model", "source" (live|cache|heuristic), "failed" (a live call was tried and failed), "headline", "short" (its first phrase), "detail" (why), "extra" (votes or a refusal), "color": Color, "tile": Vector2i (D.NO_TILE without a place), "placed": bool, "day", "clock" (feature seconds when it landed; -1 once restored from a save)}.

### Functions

- `func feature_id() -> String`
- `func setup(p_ctx: FpContext) -> void`
- `func teardown() -> void`
- `func to_dict() -> Dictionary`
- `func from_dict(d: Dictionary) -> void`
- `func self_test() -> Dictionary`
- `func cycle_feed() -> String`: J: full -> brief -> hidden -> full. Returns the new mode ("" without a HUD).
- `func route_to_newest() -> bool`: G: routes the GPS to the newest decision with a place. False when there is none or no map.
- `func newest_placed() -> Dictionary`: The newest decision with a place, or {}.
- `func where_of(it: Dictionary) -> String`: The open card's place line: "Maple Street · 240 m NE", or the mayor's district ("Citywide" for the support agents) for a decision without a place.

## `scripts/fp/activity/activity_feed.gd`

extends `Control`

The AI activity feed (feature "activity"), top right under the compass: a header with the key and whether the city's agents answer live, a line for who is deciding now (or who goes next), then the newest decisions as cards. The newest card is open: who decided (in their colour) with the model badge, what they did, why (their private thought or ruling), any votes, and a footer with where the answer came from (live, a replay, a fallback or the offline planner) and where it happened. Older cards fold to who and what. J cycles full (MAX_CARDS), brief (the newest card) and hidden (the header only).

### Constants

- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd")`
- `W = preload("res://scripts/fp/activity/activity_words.gd")`
- `WIDTH = 360.0`
- `INNER = WIDTH - 27.0`: Text width inside a card: WIDTH less the 12 px side margins and the 3 px stripe.
- `SAFE = 24.0`
- `TOP = 118.0`: Under the compass strip (it ends at y 106 in the 1600x900 base).
- `MAX_CARDS = 4`
- `FADE = 0.25`
- `FLASH = 1.6`
- `AGO_W = 44.0`: Room kept at the end of a card's top row for its age ("12 min").
- `MODES = ["full", "brief", "hidden"]`
- `OPEN_BG = Color(0.03, 0.04, 0.07, 0.74)`
- `FOLDED_BG = Color(0.03, 0.04, 0.07, 0.52)`
- `TAG_COLORS = {"LIVE": S.GOOD, "REPLAY": S.ACCENT, "FALLBACK": S.RED, "OFFLINE": S.AMBER}`
- `STATES = { "live": ["Live", S.GOOD], "down": ["Reconnecting", S.RED], "offline": ["Offline", S.A...`

### Functions

- `func setup() -> void`
- `func set_state(state: String) -> void`: Whether the city's agents answer from live model calls: "live", "down" (live calls are failing, so fallbacks answer) or "offline".
- `func state() -> String`
- `func set_line(t: String, pulse: bool) -> void`: The line under the header: who is deciding now (pulse) or who goes next; "" hides it.
- `func line_text() -> String`
- `func add_item(item: Dictionary, fresh: bool = true) -> void`: Adds a card for item (fields in ActivityFeature.items) on top and folds the one below. A fresh card fades in and flashes in its colour; a restored one (from a save) appears as it is.
- `func clear() -> void`: Drops every card (load, New City).
- `func refresh(where_of: Callable, now: float) -> void`: Refreshes every card's age and the open card's place line: where_of(item) -> String; now is the feature clock in seconds.
- `func cycle_mode() -> String`: J: full -> brief -> hidden -> full.
- `func set_mode(m: String) -> void`
- `func headlines() -> PackedStringArray`: Headlines of the cards on screen, newest first.
- `func open_card() -> Control`: The newest (open) card's panel, or null.
- `func card_count() -> int`: How many cards the feed holds (shown or not).
- `func column_rect() -> Rect2`: The header, line and cards as they sit on screen (HUD coordinates).

## `scripts/fp/activity/activity_tags.gd`

extends `Control`

Floating tags over the AI beacons (feature "activity"): for each beacon in front of the camera and within RANGE, who decided and what, with the distance, pinned above the ground at the beacon (lower when near, so a close beacon's tag stays in view). Nearest first; a tag that would leave the screen, cover a HUD area the caller keeps clear or overlap a placed tag is left out instead of being pushed to the edge. Hidden with the HUD, under modals and in photo mode.

### Constants

- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd")`
- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `RANGE = 30.0`: Tiles (world units) within which a beacon gets a tag.
- `LIFT = 14.0 * WS.M`: Height of a tag over its beacon's foot: LIFT_PER of the distance, between LIFT_MIN and LIFT.
- `LIFT_MIN = 2.5 * WS.M`
- `LIFT_PER = 0.3`
- `MAX_TAGS = 4`
- `SAFE = 24.0`
- `GAP = 4.0`

### Functions

- `func setup() -> void`
- `func show_tags(entries: Array, cam: Camera3D, me: Vector3, avoid: Array[Rect2] = []) -> void`: entries: [{"key", "pos": Vector3 (beacon foot), "who", "what", "color": Color}], me: the player's position, avoid: rects (in this control's coordinates) no tag may cover. Places up to MAX_TAGS tags for cam; [] or a null cam hides them.
- `func shown() -> Array[String]`: Keys of the beacons tagged on screen now (tests).

## `scripts/fp/activity/activity_words.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

Plain words for the AI activity layer: what a mayor's turn did ("Zoned 6 homes · Ordered a Solar Farm"), council, chaos and grid rulings, a support agent's model badge, where an answer came from (live, replay or offline), "4 min" ages and compass directions. No nodes.

### Constants

- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `ZONE_WORDS = { "R": ["home", "homes"], "C": ["shop lot", "shop lots"], "I": ["factory lot", "factory...`
- `DIRS = ["N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W", "NW"]`
- `SOURCE_TAGS = {"live": "LIVE", "cache": "REPLAY"}`
- `MAX_PARTS = 2`: Most action phrases one summary lists before "+N more".
- `DETAIL_CHARS = 150`

### Functions

- `static func mayor_model(mi: int) -> String`: The model a mayor runs on, as its badge reads ("DeepSeek-V4").
- `static func model_label(model_id: String) -> String`: A model id as a badge: the part after the vendor, without a trailing date stamp ("openai/gpt-6-luna" -> "gpt-6-luna", "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731" -> "DeepSeek-V4-Flash").
- `static func source_tag(source: String, failed: bool = false) -> String`: Where an answer came from: "LIVE" (a model call), "REPLAY" (a recorded model answer), "OFFLINE" (the built-in planner, no model involved) or, when a live call was tried and failed (failed), "FALLBACK".
- `static func summarize(applied: Array) -> String`: One line for what a mayor's turn did, from CityBrain's applied list ([{"action": Dictionary, "ok": bool, "reason": String}]).
- `static func first_refusal(applied: Array) -> String`: The first refusal reason in an applied list ("cannot afford road ($120)"), or "".
- `static func action_words(a: Variant) -> String`: A short phrase for one mayor action ({"type": "zone", "zone": "R", "w": 3, "h": 2} -> "Zoned 6 homes"), or "" for an unknown one.
- `static func politics(entry: Dictionary) -> String`: Proposals and votes from a decision entry ("Proposed the Curfew ordinance · Voted no on Clean Air Act"), or "".
- `static func council_words(r: Dictionary) -> String`: What a council ruling did ("Passed Curfew · Repealed Clean Air Act").
- `static func chaos_words(d: Dictionary) -> String`: What the Chaos Director chose ("Set off a building fire" or "Kept the city calm").
- `static func operator_words(d: Dictionary) -> String`: Which district the Grid Operator powers first ("Power goes first to Central Plaza").
- `static func detail(t: String) -> String`: Free text for a card: de-branded, one line, at most DETAIL_CHARS with an ellipsis.
- `static func tile_of(v: Variant) -> Vector2i`: A saved focus tile back as a Vector2i: CityBrain keeps a Vector2i, a JSON save turns it into "(x, y)" or [x, y]. D.NO_TILE when there is none.
- `static func direction(a: Vector3, b: Vector3) -> String`: Compass direction from a to b on the ground ("NE"), north being -Z.
- `static func ago(seconds: float, day: int) -> String`: A card's age: "now", "4 min", "2 h"; "Day 7" for one restored from a save (seconds < 0).
